question: Mahatma Gandhi headed to _________ to end the salt monopoly by introducing the Salt Satyagraha.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dandi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi headed to Dandi to end the salt monopoly by introducing the Salt Satyagraha.**
 
• Salt Satyagraha:​
 
 
• ​On March 12, 1930, Mahatma Gandhi started Salt Satyagraha from the Sabarmati Ashram.
 
• This journey is 240 km from Sabarmati Ashram.
 
• It was to end by reaching the coastal town of Dandi in Gujarat.
 
• On 6 April 1930, he reached Dandi and violated the 'Salt Law' by making a handful of salt and criminalizing himself in the eyes of the law.
 
• This is where the Civil Disobedience Movement started.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• ​​Outcomes of Salt Satyagraha​

 
 
• ​On March 5, 1931, an agreement was signed between Gandhi and Irwin, also known as the Gandhi-Irwin Pact or the Delhi Pact.

 
 
• Gandhiji had given advance notice of his Salt March” to the **Viceroy Lord Irwin,** but Irwin failed to grasp the significance of the action.
 
 
 
• Under this agreement, the demand to allow people to settle on the seashore to make and collect salt was accepted.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
